responsibilities: Design and implement robust, clean and reusable data models for the Risk, Regulatory Reporting and Finance functions that centralise reporting of financial instruments (credit cards, loans, bonds, deposits etc.) following the BIRD and IReF standards.

Define process steps and tasks to fulfil CoRep(Credit Risk, Market Risk, Operational Risk), FinRep (BS, income statements using IFRS and HGB), Liquidity Reporting (LCR, NSFR) in close collaboration with Risk, Regulatory Reporting and Finance functions and guide the departments towards better data coverage for informed business decisions and critical reporting.
Manage standardised metrics in the form of a semantic layer to serve as single points across reporting, data exploration and business intelligence.
Reconciliation Automation: Build scheduled matching programs to cross-verify the bank’s internal ledgers
Implement and maintain efficient incremental loading strategies to manage high-volume, time-series financial data.
Contribute towards the common data quality framework by applying patterns and tests.
Constantly document the processes and technologies and enable knowledge sharing.
